acquisition_method.evidence: Immunoprecipitated as well as SILAC labelled samples were analysed in data depended acquisition mode (DDA) on a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer.
For whole proteome profiling of post-nuclear lysate, samples were analysed in data independent acquisition mode (DIA) on an Orbitrap Q-Exactive plus mass spectrometer

cleavage_agent.evidence: After IP, the proteins eluted in SP3 buffer were reduced, alkylated and digested with trypsin using the SP3 protocol.
The pellets were resuspended in 8 M urea in 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB) pH 8.5, and digested with LysC and Trypsin as described previously (Schatton et al., doi: 10.7554/eLife.74552).
